verses.literal: On the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings along with the altar and all its utensils -

verses.original: וַיַּקְרִ֙יבוּ֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם הֵ֚ם נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַמַּטֹּ֔ת הֵ֥ם הָעֹמְדִ֖ים עַל־ הַפְּקֻדִֽים׃

verses.literal: And the leaders of Israel the heads of their families . . . presented an offering These men were the tribal . . . leaders who had supervised . . . the registration

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ קָרְבָּנָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־ עֶגְלֹ֥ת צָב֙ וּשְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֔ר עֲגָלָ֛ה עַל־ שְׁנֵ֥י הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים וְשׁ֣וֹר לְאֶחָ֑ד וַיַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אוֹתָ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

verses.literal: They brought as their offering before the LORD six covered carts and twelve . . . oxen an ox from each leader and a cart from every two leaders and presented them before the tabernacle

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm bā·qār šə·na·yim ’ê·lim ḥă·miš·šāh ‘at·tu·ḏîm ḥă·miš·šāh kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh ḥă·miš·šāh zeh qā·rə·ban ’ă·ḥî·ra‘ ben- ‘ê·nān
verses.literal: and a peace offering . . . of two oxen five rams five male goats and five male lambs a year old . . . This was the offering of Ahira son of Enan

verses.original: זֹ֣את׀ חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ בְּיוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל קַעֲרֹ֨ת כֶּ֜סֶף שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֗ה מִֽזְרְקֵי־ כֶ֙סֶף֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֔ר כַּפּ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ ḥă·nuk·kaṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ bə·yō·wm him·mā·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw mê·’êṯ nə·śî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl qa·‘ă·rōṯ ke·sep̄ šə·têm ‘eś·rêh miz·rə·qê- ḵe·sep̄ šə·nêm ‘ā·śār kap·pō·wṯ zā·hāḇ šə·têm ‘eś·rêh
verses.literal: So these were the offerings from the leaders of Israel for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed - twelve . . . silver platters twelve . . . silver bowls and twelve . . . gold dishes

verses.original: שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָ֗ה הַקְּעָרָ֤ה הָֽאַחַת֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים הַמִּזְרָ֣ק הָאֶחָ֑ד כֹּ֚ל כֶּ֣סֶף הַכֵּלִ֔ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵא֖וֹת בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šîm ū·mê·’āh haq·qə·‘ā·rāh hā·’a·ḥaṯ ke·sep̄ wə·šiḇ·‘îm ham·miz·rāq hā·’e·ḥāḏ kōl ke·sep̄ hak·kê·lîm ’al·pa·yim wə·’ar·ba‘- mê·’ō·wṯ bə·še·qel haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Each silver platter weighed a hundred and thirty shekels . . . and each silver bowl seventy shekels The total weight of the silver articles was two thousand four hundred shekels according to the sanctuary shekel

verses.original: כַּפּ֨וֹת זָהָ֤ב שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ מְלֵאֹ֣ת קְטֹ֔רֶת עֲשָׂרָ֧ה עֲשָׂרָ֛ה הַכַּ֖ף בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כָּל־ זְהַ֥ב הַכַּפּ֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּמֵאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kap·pō·wṯ zā·hāḇ šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh mə·lê·’ōṯ qə·ṭō·reṯ ‘ă·śā·rāh ‘ă·śā·rāh hak·kap̄ bə·še·qel haq·qō·ḏeš kāl- zə·haḇ hak·kap·pō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm ū·mê·’āh
verses.literal: The twelve . . . gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each according to the sanctuary shekel The total weight of the gold dishes was a hundred and twenty shekels

verses.original: כָּל־ הַבָּקָ֨ר לָעֹלָ֜ה שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר פָּרִ֗ים אֵילִ֤ם שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂר֙ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר וּמִנְחָתָ֑ם וּשְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֛ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hab·bā·qār lā·‘ō·lāh šə·nêm ‘ā·śār pā·rîm ’ê·lim šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh šə·nêm ‘ā·śār ū·min·ḥā·ṯām ū·śə·‘î·rê ‘iz·zîm šə·nêm ‘ā·śār lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: All the livestock for the burnt offering totaled twelve . . . bulls twelve . . . rams and twelve . . . male lambs a year old . . . together with their grain offerings and twelve . . . male goats . . . for the sin offering

verses.original: וְכֹ֞ל בְּקַ֣ר׀ זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֗ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֮ פָּרִים֒ אֵילִ֤ם שִׁשִּׁים֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים שִׁשִּׁ֔ים כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֖ה שִׁשִּׁ֑ים זֹ֚את חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אַחֲרֵ֖י הִמָּשַׁ֥ח אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl bə·qar ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh pā·rîm ’ê·lim šiš·šîm ‘at·tu·ḏîm šiš·šîm kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh šiš·šîm zōṯ ḥă·nuk·kaṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’a·ḥă·rê him·mā·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: All the livestock sacrificed for the peace offering totaled twenty-four . . . bulls sixty rams sixty male goats and sixty male lambs a year old . . . This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed

verses.original: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּוֹ֒ וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע אֶת־ הַקּ֜וֹל מִדַּבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו מֵעַ֤ל הַכַּפֹּ֙רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת מִבֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֑ים וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḇō mō·šeh ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lə·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw way·yiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- haq·qō·wl mid·dab·bêr ’ê·lāw mê·‘al hak·kap·pō·reṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- ’ă·rōn hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ mib·bên šə·nê hak·kə·ru·ḇîm way·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: When Moses entered . . . the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony Thus the LORD spoke to him
